summary: Nora can look at a picture or a video somebody shared a link to (a Google Drive photo or clip), the same way she looks at one sent in the chat.
details: The link's code, the pasted link, or a link she built around the code all work; the file is fetched fresh on every look and nothing about it is kept.
A shared file that is not a picture or video is pointed at the file reader, and a file not shared with her account says how to share it.
A code that a sent picture and a shared file's link both have is asked about, never guessed.
limitations: A file over the source's 10 MB cap is refused.
